answer: Shared physical-resource attestation: each identity must periodically submit a reading from a hardware sensor it physically possesses, bound to its key and co-located with a second sensor held by a different operator. Sensors are calibrated to detect local conditions — a tundra cold-snap, an oasis humidity spike, an orchard soil reading — so a single operator cannot fabricate divergent readings across many identities without owning many physically distinct, calibrated devices.
